_comment: NOT-IN-WAVE-QUEUED-1. Is this plan machine left out of the migration as
the pages and the record show it? ONE answer, decided in two languages:
the engine and the service (Test-VmfEntryOutsideRun, PowerShell) and the
A machine is left out when it is in no wave (no wave name, or the planner's
unscheduled - the only word the engine skips), the plan would move it
(any path but MANUAL or EXCLUDED), and it has no state document. No wave
takes it, so it never moves until a person puts it in a wave again in the
wave editor, which still lists it. A machine with a state document has
history and is always shown. MANUAL and EXCLUDED machines are always
shown: the Migrations page says why the plan does not move them.
